name: Borgo dei Conti Resort
positioning: Country resort in the Umbrian countryside near Perugia, restored by Spagnulo & Partners with period frescoes, coffered ceilings and a spa in the villa's western wing
best_for: Travelers who want frescoed historic suites in the Umbrian countryside
Couples looking for a countryside base with a spa, an infinity pool and forest trails

facts.text: The resort is set in the Umbrian countryside near Perugia.
The resort was restored by the Spagnulo & Partners architectural studio, integrating local craftsmanship and Renaissance art elements.
Room types include the Rossi Scotti Apartments, the Conti Suite and the Conte Suite.
Dining includes fine dining at Cedri Restaurant, casual meals at Osteria del Borgo and drinks at the Lounge Bar.
Activities include outdoor cinema, picnics in the olive grove, cooking classes, wine tasting and truffle hunting.
The area around the resort has Etruscan remnants, medieval villages and hamlets.
A winding road leads up through an ilex forest to the estate buildings.
Rooms all have roomy double-sink bathrooms.
Perugia is less than half an hour away by car.
Pets are welcome, and five terrace suites are advised for dog owners.

highlights.text: The Conte and Contessa piano nobile suites have original frescoed friezes and ornate heraldic fireplaces.
Rooms feature period frescoes, coffered ceilings and views of the countryside or the resort's cloister.
The spa is in the villa's western wing and offers indoor and outdoor wellness experiences.
The resort has an outdoor infinity pool and forest walking trails.

considerations.text: The resort has a seasonal opening from April to November.
WhataHotel notes the secluded countryside location requires a car for city access.
